mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, title, preview, message_count, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, session_id, title, preview, message_count, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversation_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.user_id, CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'wx' WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'admin' ELSE 'unknown' END AS user_type, COALESCE(w.open_id, a.username, CAST(s.user_id AS CHAR)) AS user_subject, COALESCE(w.nickname, a.display_name, CONCAT('user-', s.user_id)) AS user_display_name, s.session_id, s.title, s.preview, s.message_count, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM agent_conversation_session s LEFT JOIN wx_user w ON w.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN admin_user a ON a.id = s.user_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
